tool_input.description: Probe findWrapPos, createPadding, rtrim edge cases
Write probe Java source to tmp dir via heredoc

result:
Good — only our new test class exists (`*AgentTest.java`), so this confirms the full suite is clean except for the one genuine bug.

I created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/cli/HelpFormatterAgentTest.java` with 49 tests covering getters/setters, `createPadding`, `rtrim`, `findWrapPos`, `renderWrappedText`, `printWrapped`, `printUsage` (including option groups and required options), `printOptions`/`renderOptions`, and `printHelp` (including validation and header/footer/auto-usage behavior).

48 tests pass. One test fails and shows a real bug:

- **`testFindWrapPosNoWhitespaceAnywhereInText`** — `HelpFormatter.findWrapPos("abcdefghij", 4, 0)` throws `StringIndexOutOfBoundsException` instead of returning a valid wrap position (or `-1`, per its own javadoc: "or -1 if the wrap position is at the end of the text"). The forward-scanning loop in `findWrapPos` (`HelpFormatter.java:936-941`) uses the condition `pos <= text.length()` and then calls `text.charAt(pos)`, which is out of bounds when `pos == text.length()`. This is reachable from public API too: any `printWrapped`/`renderWrappedText` call with a single unbroken "word" longer than `width` that runs all the way to the end of the string with no trailing whitespace will throw instead of wrapping gracefully.
